scope: Attempts omitted from the earlier reviewed findings. Each record pins one attempt's saved configuration snapshot and algorithm source, so a later attempt never inherits the finding.

vio-lc/rosariov2/sequence1/airslam/run1.explanation: Saved AirSLAM Rosario camera file sets T_body_cam0 to identity (comment: cam0 IS the body frame); AirSLAM links IMU and camera poses through it (src/airslam/src/frame.cc). Same defect as the Basalt/OpenVINS/Voxel-SVIO attempts; omitted from the 2026-10-01 list.

vio/hortimulti/strawberry02/basalt/run1.explanation: Saved Basalt HortiMulti calibration uses accel/gyro noise 0.5/0.006 from a July tuning commit (388767c) with no recorded basis; the documented HortiMulti profile is 0.110/0.0035. The same rerun also settles the unresolved native time-offset question, because the current runner applies the offset to the IMU input.
